policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

protocol.accounting: Research acquires 32 actual full objective/constraint vectors once per distinct initial task and shares them across both arms and same-task stable/change profiles. All loaded calls count toward each arm's N64. New revision questions replace ordinary optimizer calls inside the same remaining 32 calls; full history is retained. Historical reuse, new acquisition, extra model compute, and independent evaluation calls are separate.
metrics: final Program and active GP generalization MSE
common misfit, question, fresh validation, and scope adoption sequence
protocol.scope: 409 historical cases plus27 fresh confirmation/stress cases: three seeds and nine profiles per seed fixed before acquisition. First run the original sixteen development cases. Freeze the method before acquiring any of the new measurements; preserve all regressions.
protocol.reuse_accounting: All historical initialization and evaluator measurements already exist. The first sixteen v0.48 runs cost512 online calls. Full historical coverage needs169 additional v0.47 runs and185 v0.48 runs, including those sixteen once:354 runs/11328 online calls. Both arms run on27 fresh cases:54 additional runs/1728 online calls. Fresh initialization384 and evaluation1920 give408 actual optimizer runs/13056 online and15360 physical calls. Reused trajectories are not new optimizer executions. No vanilla/CodeAgent runs.
protocol.baseline_revision_evidence: Keep the original four-observation batch size and nine-times-frozen-reference threshold. Nonoverlapping actual measurement batches reopen research when both models' batch MSE exceed the threshold and at least two individual rows exceed it for both models. The new scope starts at the earliest such counterexample and retains every subsequently paid row. Eight coverage calls and four fresh validation calls remain inside N64. No change labels, times, or truth values reach the controller.
protocol.research_initialization: Fresh initial research uses the saved0.40 compiler and the unchanged public completion rule to32 actual full vectors, shared across arms and same-task profiles. Initial and independent evaluation vectors are acquired once and separately charged.
protocol.outlier_control: The actual simulator runs normally and its constraint output receives the frozen +1.0 observation disturbance on the thirteenth online call only. Objectives, future measurements, and evaluator truth remain unchanged. A report-only log records the disturbance; the runtime receives only ordinary measured outputs and public controls. The corresponding ordinary stable case receives no disturbance. Initial data and final evaluation measurements are shared with that stable case.
protocol.mixed_control: The StatePolicy simulator supplies one +1.0 constraint observation at global stage41 (online9), with unchanged objective and future observations. Starting at global stage45 (online13), both actual objective and constraint mechanisms switch to RZDT2. The runtime receives only public controls and ordinary simulator outputs; changes and disturbances are report-only. This asks whether observation repair preserves sensitivity to later drift.
protocol.objective_only_control: Starting at global stage45, objectives f1/f2 use the upstream RZDT2 mean mechanism, while f3 retains StatePolicyRZDT1. A script-owned StatePolicyRZDT1 subclass composes the upstream deterministic mean methods and inherits the same TestProblem.simulate: one three-output Gaussian draw is one actual observation, with no uncharged second simulator query. Final independent evaluation uses this same hybrid mechanism. The controller receives ordinary controls and measured outputs, without change labels.
protocol.baseline_scope: v0.47 contains the executed v0.42 policy plus objective validation resumption during unresolved constraint research and ordinary paid-label sharing. Sixteen actual v0.47 outcomes exist; other affected cases require new baseline executions.
protocol.new_method: Retain a frozen objective candidate when its first four predictions have positive but uncertain improvement. Continue in affordable pairs chosen for discrimination and terminal value, without weakening the existing lower-gain adoption threshold. Retain shared paid controls and reject non-positive candidates. No active-noise changes.
protocol.reuse_rule: Reuse an old v0.42 trajectory only when its complete objective state contains no scope event, active scope, attempt, revision or validation request/outcome. Both v0.47 and v0.48 changes require entry into objective scope validation. Run six such controls from the sixteen-case replay; reuse the other unchanged method paths. The remaining 179 cases require actual v0.47 baselines; ten exist, so acquire the missing169.
